title: Select text followed by multi-cursor shortcut breaks
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.1, v.4.7.2
- Worked last: N/A
(I feel like it's been an issue for awhile, but it's highly reproducible; so anyone can pitch in if they test other versions.)

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8129) - AMD Ryzen AI 7 350 w/ Radeon 860M (16 threads) - 15.28 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The text selection gets wild when using the Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down shortcuts to create extra text cursors after having just cleared a selection with the arrow keys.

### Steps to reproduce

Reproduction steps:
- Open a script with some code in Godot's code editor
- Select any portion of the code (with mouse or keyboard)
- Press one of the arrow keys to move the cursor and clear the selection
- Press Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down to generate a new text cursor

At this point, the previously selected text appears to become selected again, from the previous anchor to the new text cursor.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

MRP not applicable here, but here's a video to help clarify:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1d70fe33-6eff-4a79-a39a-8df9e1dbdbde

Actions:
- Mouse selection
- Up Arrow
- Ctrl + Shift + Down Arrow
- Down Arrow x 3
- Ctrl + Shift + Down Arrow
